alt: April 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of a dark green pond seen from above, covered in lily pads with white water lilies. Mahavir’s birthday, Ambedkar’s birthday and Good Friday are marked.
caption: A watercolor illustration of a pond with lily pads and white flowers for April 2025
description: An artistic depiction of a lily pad pond uses a loose watercolor style to create a textured dark green background. Several large, vibrant green lily pads with radial lines cover the surface, interspersed with smaller floating leaves. Four delicate white water lilies with yellow centers are scattered throughout the composition. The entire painting is framed by light blue and teal paint splatters.
